Several humanoid robots are commercially available for purchase in 2026.
The **AgiBot X2** is available in France via JoyBuy from €17,889, and globally via store.agibot.com.
**Unitree G1** is available globally from $16,000 through Unitree's website and authorized resellers.
**AgiBot A2 Series** and **G2 industrial** models are available through store.agibot.com and Minth Group in Europe.
**Boston Dynamics Spot** (quadruped, not bipedal) is available from $74,500 via Boston Dynamics.
Several premium platforms — including Tesla Optimus, Figure 02, and Boston Dynamics Atlas NG — are not yet commercially available for external purchase.

# Unitree R1
...
Model:
R1 AIR
- R1 AIR
- R1

...
**Unitree R1 is a compact humanoid robot built for projects that need a practical biped platform without the footprint of a full-size machine.** It stands 1,230 mm tall and weighs about 27-29 kg with the battery, depending on the model.
R1 comes in three versions: R1 AIR, R1 and R1 EDU.
They share the same basic frame, but differ in joint count, vision hardware and support for development add-ons.
...
- **R1** adds waist and neck movement, binocular vision and 26 joints for more expressive whole-body motion.
- **R1 EDU** is the development model.
It supports 26-40 joints, optional dexterous hands and an NVIDIA Jetson Orin module.

content.text:
Several humanoid robots are orderable in Asia, especially from Chinese manufacturers; availability and shipping depend on the country. Examples include Unitree R1 and G1, AgiBot X2 and A2 Lite, Noetix BUMI models, and AiMOGA Mornine M1.[5][7][8]

| Robot | Indicative price | Availability |
|---|---:|---|
| Unitree R1 | About US$4,900–5,900 | Manufacturer store; also listed on regional marketplaces[8] |
| Unitree G1 | About US$13,500 | Manufacturer store and resellers[5][8] |
| AgiBot X2 | About US$17,889 and up | AgiBot store; international availability varies[2][8] |
| AgiBot A2 Lite | About US$44,560 | AgiBot store[8] |
| Noetix BUMI | About US$4,995–5,995 for listed standard models | Specialist sellers; check delivery and support in your country[7] |
| AiMOGA Mornine M1 | About ¥285,800 in China | JD.com in China[8] |
| UBTECH Cruzr 1S | About US$12,000–16,000 | Specialist robotics suppliers[1][3] |

These are advertised prices, not guaranteed delivered costs; taxes, freight, configuration, and local support can change the total. Larger industrial robots such as UBTECH Walker S2 are generally sold through enterprise procurement rather than ordinary online checkout.[2][8]
